---
title: "Welcome & First Steps"
description: "Checklist for your first week in the lab."
---

Welcome to the Omnia Lab! First, read the [Lab Manual](lab-manual.qmd) — it
covers how the lab works and what's expected of everyone. Then work through this
checklist in your first week.

## Accounts and access

- [ ] GitHub account added to the [Omnia-Lab-UC](https://github.com/Omnia-Lab-UC) organization
- [ ] Lab [Zulip](https://omnialab.zulipchat.com/) account
- [ ] University credentials and building access
- [ ] Server / HPC account (see [Computing](../computing/index.qmd))
- [ ] Seat in the lab's Claude organization, if you'll use AI tools (ask Tomás)

## Reading

- [ ] Skim this wiki, especially [Data](../data/index.qmd) conventions
- [ ] Before using AI tools for lab work, read [AI Tools and Lab Data](../data/ai-tools-and-lab-data.qmd)
- [ ] Ask your advisor for the current core papers to read

## Expectations

Meeting attendance, working hours, and communication norms are covered in the
[Lab Manual](lab-manual.qmd).
